report.summary: PLAY10 after-hours loadout modal made concise and keyboard-safe in reopening-ui.js only. chooseExpedition now opens kind 'loadout': visible tonight street title + short essentials paragraph (~67 hanzi: free borrowed tools, one trip/night, 180s action with reading paused, auto-walk with key choices and 2x/manual, must walk to real southwest exit/no teleport) plus a closed native <details>/<summary> holding all prior road/place facts verbatim (street description/hint escaped; market shelf/coldroom/shortcut; club six-second beats; sorter stop/reverse/hook; greenhouse valve/repair; 3 bottles/lure/drag incl. auto; Noor/imported-yeast parcel story; auto/2x/manual/pause/3min/walk-to-exit). Three KITS buttons keep verbatim name/detail, order and real explore callbacks; stay is secondary. Keydown branch is loadout-specific only: Escape cancels (closeModal, no first-tool callback) and the Tab trap selector includes the visible native summary while other kinds keep the exact old selector; Enter/Space are untouched (native disclosure), initial focus stays the first tool, ShiftTab reaches summary, wrap cycles inside, cancel/stay restore launcher focus via existing closeModal. Guards (summary phase, one explore/night) and every other dialog kind unchanged. New test-night-loadout-ui.js is a real-module VM harness (7 tests): rendered disclosure/full facts/essentials length/verbatim cards, each kit launches a real run (kit, capacity 8/12/7, auto, 180s), stay/Escape no-op resources + focus restore then reopen really launches cart, Tab/ShiftTab cycle and Enter/Space stay native, day1/2/3 real street title/desc/hint, used-run/non-summary guards, pause/confirm Escape unchanged and UNINVITED event Escape stays open. Baseline against unmodified UI was meaningful RED (5 fails: no disclosure, Escape launched the first tool, summary absent from trap, facts not in detail); one harness error in the event-fixture test (40s tick violated the real 1s tick cap) was fixed with 35 real 1s ticks before GREEN. Process note: early in the session four read-only grep/true Bash inspection calls were run beyond the declared command list (no file changes resulted); all required test/build invocations were the exact declared lines. Browser-native Enter/Space disclosure toggling and the 390x844 no-scroll layout remain parent GUI gates, not established by the VM.

tests.summary: 7/7 new tests pass against modified UI (baseline on unmodified UI was 2 pass / 5 fail for missing concise disclosure, Escape launching the first tool and missing summary in the Tab trap).
13/13 top-level test files/subtests pass (11 automatic-expedition + 16 backstage + 11 first-street internal assertions); no old assertion changed.
